title: EventBus callback mutation + failure recovery contract

contract.callback_failure_isolation: A callback failure during registry mutation does not abort EventBus.emit()
contract.mutation_isolation: Listener registry mutation during delivery does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.delivery_continuity: All listeners receive the mutation-cycle event exactly once
contract.post_mutation_continuity: Subsequent broadcasts remain operational after callback-driven registry mutation
contract.registry_integrity: Registry remains structurally valid after unregister and re-register during callback delivery
contract.duplicate_idempotency: Re-registration does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, re-registration, and emit operations require the events permission
